description: The agent must execute a precise multi-step workflow: (1) Run send-code --email wxm_test_2024@lafeitu-user.com to request a verification code. (2) Run register --email ... --password ... --code 847291 --reset-visitor to create the account — critically, the --reset-visitor flag must be used to clear anonymous session data, a proprietary constraint not obvious without reading SKILL.md. (3) Run search or get commands to resolve exact product slugs and valid variant integers: 'get lengchi-tu' returns variants [150, 200, 300] so variant 200 is the integer 200; 'get shousi-tu' returns variants [200, 400] so variant 400. (4) Run add-cart lengchi-tu --variant 200 --quantity 2 (increments to 2), then run update-cart lengchi-tu --variant 200 --quantity 3 (sets absolute to 3) — per SKILL.md, add-cart increments while update-cart sets absolute quantity; naive agents may use add-cart multiple times getting wrong quantities. (5) Run add-cart shousi-tu --variant 400 --quantity 1. (6) Run create-order with all 5 required fields: --name, --phone, --province, --city, --address. (7) Capture the JSON response (order_id + payment_url) and save it to order_result.json. The eval verifies: correct email registration with reset_visitor=True in mock state, token saved to ~/.openclaw/credentials/..., correct variant integers used, lengchi-tu qty exactly 3, shousi-tu qty 1, all shipping fields present, and order_result.json contains a real LFT-prefixed order_id matching the mock server state.
